statement: Once durable cluster identity exists, the raw union over every nodes-p* replica file is replaced by a small local membership manifest (or, at minimum, contradictory replica DBs are treated as conflicting rather than unioned), and readAuthoritativeRows returns a typed {state, rows} outcome so that an unavailable authority defers rejoin instead of silently collapsing to the fresh path with a downgraded row. doneWhen: the test-receipt probe reads solve/evidence/startup-evidence-single-identity-decision-v2.receipt.json with outstanding 0 — typed-outcome and conflict-detection receipts passing (deterministic red-on-revert evidence harness).

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

This Quest consumes the durable cluster_id minted by durable-cluster-identity; the membership manifest and conflict detection key on cluster identity, so it must not be started before that Quest's mint-and-persist frontier lands.

readAuthoritativeRows must distinguish missing/readable/unavailable; transient authority unavailability defers rejoin with a typed deferred outcome (not silent absence), so the durable-rejoin fast path is not silently defeated and the row is not downgraded to JOINING with a fresh created_at.

The fall-through from an unavailable authority must remain a serialized, self-keyed, retry-wrapped upsert that throws on real unavailability; the typed outcome must not introduce a path that can clobber another node's row.
Each new regression test must fail when the typed-outcome or conflict-detection mechanism is reverted while the rest of the change remains.
